card.title: NightShift — what I achieved
card.subtitle: Trillion-parameter AI on Arm CPUs, no GPU — and hand-written Arm kernels that beat production llama.cpp. A recap of the measured results.

card.title: Frontier models run — and run faster — on Arm CPUs
card.subtitle: • First known CPU inference of Kimi K3 (2.8T) on Arm   • K2 (1.04T), Maverick (400B), Qwen3-30B all served on one VM   • A hand-written SMMLA kernel beats llama.cpp   • Speculative decoding: 1.66x, accuracy-free

card.title: Active params, not total size, set CPU speed
card.subtitle: A flagship 400B Llama 4 Maverick (17B active) hits 22 tok/s — faster than the 1T Kimi K2. It's all governed by the memory-bandwidth roofline.
